semantic.justification: Task166a: the original generated base and derived exception values now share one base-first JavaScript initialization unit. Public Exception/RuntimeException paths reexport the same actual classes; unchanged value/member bodies and the original cached type factory preserve the existing contracts. This resolves the actual Exception -> Reference -> Any/genfunc -> RuntimeException eager heritage cycle, without consumer import-order workarounds, new registry, prototype installer or lifetime mechanism. C++ header/declaration ordering and ESM value evaluation are distinct language responsibilities. No full parity claim follows.
